name: localization-next-v14
description: Next.js 14 App Router demo of dependency-free i18n (en/de) with locale-based routing, Accept-Language detection via middleware, and typed server/client translation hooks. Includes cookie-based auth guards, protected routes, PocketBase backend, and dark/light theming with Mantine UI.

paragraphs: A Next.js 14 App Router example showing how to build locale-aware routing and translation without any i18n library — plus a realistic app shell around it: authentication, protected routes, and theming.
features: 🌍 Dependency-free i18n — locale-based routing (/en, /de) handled entirely with Next.js middleware, accept-language header parsing, and lazy-loaded JSON dictionaries (server-only)

🔀 Dual translation hooks — useServerTranstaltion for Server Components and useClientTranstaltion (built on React's use() hook) for Client Components, both sharing the same typed t() translation function with…
🔐 Cookie-based auth guard — protected route layout validates a JWT-derived user via a server-side check, redirecting unauthenticated users to sign-in
🎨 Theming — light/dark mode and color theme switching via Mantine
🧱 Realistic app shell — sign-in / register / verify flows, billing pages, nav, notifications — structured the way a real product would be, not a toy demo
